description.value: Hong Kong Flavor Restaurant is a Hong Kong-style Chinese eatery in Richmond serving a broad menu that spans breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, and dinner. The restaurant runs seasonal specials including elaborate Lunar New Year poon choi (basin feast) sets that require advance booking. It is wheelchair accessible and offers both dine-in and takeout service.
